description: React component for configuring zoom settings in a visualization, including shape selection, base dimensions, slope, exponent, and rendering a zoom configuration chart.

classes.name: ZoomConfigControl
classes.description: React functional component for managing zoom configuration controls.

methods.name: onChartChange
methods.description: Handles updates from the zoom configuration chart.

methods.name: onBaseWidthChange
methods.description: Updates the base width and recalculates values.

methods.name: onBaseHeightChange
methods.description: Updates the base height and recalculates values.

methods.name: onBaseSlopeChange
methods.description: Updates the slope if applicable and recalculates values.

methods.name: onBaseExponentChange
methods.description: Updates the exponent if applicable and recalculates values.

methods.name: onShapeChange
methods.description: Switches between fixed, linear, and exponential zoom configurations.
